title: Aqua Aspect
body:
This mod is very simple and adds the enchantment Aqua Aspect. Aqua Aspect gives a buff to damage dealt on nether mobs and enderman and the **ENDER DRAGON**. There are 2 levels of Aqua Aspect
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

*Aqua Aspect I* can almost one shot enderman with diamond sword with no crit.
***Aqua Aspect II*** can one shot everything which is a nether mob or an enderman.

</details>
